title: Verify "last modified" date is displayed and formatted consistently
steps: Inspect its date format and surrounding spacing/typography
expected_result: The "last modified" date is visible, uses a consistent, human-readable date format, and its typography/spacing matches the rest of the page's body text style.

title: Verify contact info block renders with correct formatting
steps: Scroll to the contact info block (typically at the end of the document)
Inspect line breaks, spacing, and any linked contact details (e.g. email/address) for correct rendering
expected_result: The contact info block renders with clear line breaks between distinct fields, consistent spacing/typography with the rest of the page, and any linked contact details (e.g. mailto links) are correctly formatted and functional.
